name: 56069 · Montgomery, MN
findings: ZIP 56069 (Montgomery) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56069 (Montgomery) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56069 (Montgomery) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
